_comment: Studio usage caps: Benjamin's requirement (codex-claude-paperclip-model-routing-research.md sections 2-3). Percentage points of each provider's own windows. Changing a cap needs Benjamin's approval.

claude._five_hour_comment: Benjamin, 2026-11-04: lowered with the weekly cap (was 30, matched to the old 80-point week). The week now limits the studio (week_pace below), so this only stops one window's burst, and it always leaves him at least 80% of every window.
claude._weekly_comment: Benjamin, 2026-11-04: he now uses Claude personally a lot more, so the studio's share of the account week drops from 80 to 35 and his reserved share rises from 20 to 60. Measured personal use (studio.jsonl caps lines): 61 the week of Sep 29, 26 and 31 the next two, and 18 in the first 36 hours of the week from Nov 3, about 13 a day. 35 + 60 + margins fits under 100. Benjamin, 2026-11-10: his personal assistant (Hermes) now runs on this Claude account too, so the studio's share drops from 35 to 20; build work already goes to Codex first (clerk build_on_codex).
claude._account_stop_comment: Benjamin, 2026-11-04: the studio never takes the account week past 90%, whoever used the rest, so he keeps at least 10% even in a week when his own use passes 60. A run is asked to wrap up there (lib/quota.py account_stop). Benjamin, 2026-11-10: lowered from 90 to 75 so the studio stops using Claude earlier in a heavy personal week.
claude._pace_comment: Benjamin, 2026-11-04: as for Codex, each day may use the week left spread over the days to its reset, so the studio slows down through the week instead of spending its 35 in two days and stopping. Not a cap.

reserve._comment: Benjamin, 2026-10-14: the Director must always be able to run. Other agents work to five_hour_cap minus this; the agents are Paperclip agent ids (8ec720d9: Director).

codex._weekly_comment: Benjamin, 2026-11-08: his personal assistant (Hermes Agent) now runs on this Codex account, so the studio's share of the Codex week drops from 100 to 80 and his reserved share rises from 0 to 20. Review after a week of measured Hermes use.
codex._pace_comment: Benjamin, 2026-10-18: Codex spent 78 of its week in a day and a half. Each day may use the week left spread over the days to its reset (lib/quota.py week_pace). Not a cap.
codex._spare_comment: Benjamin, 2026-10-18: when Codex's week left, spread over the days to its reset, is under this many points a day, the Clerk moves Codex-Builder's waiting tasks to the Claude Builders and keeps Codex for reviews (lib/clerk.py spare_codex). Not a cap.

no_grace._comment: Benjamin, 2026-10-15: these agents get no wrap-up grace; at the cap they are stopped at the next check. Codex-Principal (31ff44ca) used 81 points of a 60-point window in 10 minutes.
